status_at_registration: 2025 files not yet acquired or scored in this stage
selection_interval: 2023-09-01 through 2023-12-31; all target timestamps strictly before 2024
evaluation_mode: Prequential. All architecture and hyperparameters frozen before 2025 acquisition. Adaptive candidates may learn only previously issued, fully matured 2025 forecast errors; no test-year offline tuning. Public historical data are not a private blind challenge or independent validation.
target: WVHT^2 * APD, units m^2 s; wave-activity proxy, not electricity or calibrated wave power
timestamps: Reuse Stage 3 exact-time parser and target matcher. No time compression, interpolation, future truth fill, duplicate timestamps, or year substitution. Observation times are treated as availability times, not verified real dissemination timestamps.
ridge: Train only pre-September 2023 exact-target pairs. Predict target minus current using current, exact 1/3/6/12/24-hour lags and 1/2/3/6-hour rolling means. Standardize with training-only moments; intercept unpenalized. Nonnegative predictions. Incomplete feature histories fall back to persistence.
baselines: best rolling expert selected on late-2023 MAE
best of all seven experts selected on late-2023 MAE

adaptive_candidates.delayed_router_v01: One expert chosen per UTC day using only earlier issued errors with target+latency strictly before that day's start. Last 14 origin-days; at least 96 pairs across at least 5 days. Shrink each MAE using 48 pseudo-observations at its late-2023 MAE. Switch away from frozen static champion only if estimated MAE is at least 2% lower. Otherwise retain champion.
adaptive_candidates.delayed_blend_v01: Same matured-loss estimates and warmup. Weights exp(-4*(loss-min(loss))/max(median(loss),1e-12)), normalized. Forecast is 50% frozen champion plus 50% expert-weighted blend. Standard expert-aggregation ingredients; no novelty or regret-bound claim.

missing_history_policy: Rolling history requires 80% of calibration cadence expectation; unavailable expert forecasts fall back to persistence and are counted. Forecast only at actual valid current observations. Missing targets are withheld and count against match coverage.
primary_metric: Pooled matched-origin mean absolute error. All methods use identical origin/target pairs. Report absolute errors, effect sizes, days worse, quarterly results, and upper-5%-truth error diagnostics.
hypothesis_family: 6 stations x 3 horizons x 2 adaptive candidates x 3 preselected comparators; missing-source hypotheses remain in multiplicity denominator
uncertainty: 10000 paired circular moving-calendar-day bootstrap replicates, 7-day primary and 14-day sensitivity, fixed seed 20260905. Centered-null one-sided p, Holm over 108. Intervals are pointwise and model-dependent, not guaranteed under arbitrary nonstationarity.
pair_screen: At least 2000 pairs, 120 scored days, 80% exact-target match coverage, >=5% pooled MAE improvement, 7-day Holm p<0.05, both 7-day and 14-day pointwise lower limits >0.
candidate_cell_screen: All three comparator screens must pass for same station/horizon/candidate. Passing only persistence is insufficient. No retrospective best-baseline promotion.
uncertainty_diagnostic: Nominal 90% symmetric empirical intervals from prior 28 origin-days of fully matured candidate errors, minimum 96 pairs, otherwise late-2023 static-champion absolute-error quantile. Report coverage and width; no conformal or safety guarantee.
stress_diagnostics: Only preselected station 46237 at 60m: drop 10% of input observations with seed 42, remove first 3h of each 14-day interval, and increase feedback latency to 90m. Keep clean observed future truth. Do not infer significance or expand claim family from these diagnostics; report origin availability as well as conditional MAE.
source_failure_policy: Preserve failed-source receipt and all successes; do not replace station or year. Research completeness and workflow success are separate fields.
integrity_tests: Future-value mutation, unmatured-label mutation, exact-time gaps, missing truths, late-source rejection, duplicate rejection, training-only fit/selection, warmup fallback, convex weights, deterministic seeds, hash drift, constant-series and empty-source behavior.
scope: Offline public-data software research. No equipment control, production deployment, DNS changes, credential changes, valuation claim, independently validated performance, or realized energy/revenue benefit.
prior_work: Reuse Stage 3 parser, exact-time pairing, hashes and paired bootstrap. Candidate implements the existing LumenCore model-routing concept using explicit new standard loss-aggregation heuristics, not an assertion that a previously proven proprietary algorithm was deployed.
